svg.aria-label: focus-gate: a real run in a temp folder
svg.text: focus-gate: a real run in a temp folder

text.tspan: node focus-gate.mjs < logo.json | grep -o 'FOCUS GATE ON ([^)]*)\|Reply in[^:]*: ..Essay first[^.]*'

g.text: FOCUS GATE ON (1 item not begun)
Reply in one or two warm, firm lines: \"Essay first\", the single next step from the list above, and offer to st
art it with them right now

text.tspan: # open the starter and save it without changing anything (same size): still on
touch essay.docx && node focus-gate.mjs < logo.json | grep -o 'FOCUS GATE ON ([^)]*)'

g.text: FOCUS GATE ON (1 item not begun)

text.tspan: # on the bus home: hold keeps it quiet until you say you have settled
node focus-gate.mjs < logo.json | grep -o 'Focus gate HELD[^;]*'

g.text: Focus gate HELD while the user is in transit (bus home

text.tspan: node focus-gate.mjs < settled.json | grep -o 'FOCUS GATE ON ([^)]*)'

g.text: FOCUS GATE ON (1 item not begun)

text.tspan: # a real edit: the size changes, the gate lifts and the hook goes silent
echo ' The causes of the war were' >> essay.docx && node focus-gate.mjs < logo.json; echo "exit $? (no output)"
